Hi Samantha — appreciate you sending these over. Quick notes after an initial review: 

- COI: We require either an "additional insured" endorsement on the General Liability policy OR the insurer to add the following wording in the certificate remarks: "Redwood Inference, its subsidiaries and affiliates, and their officers, directors and employees are named as additional insureds." The certificate you sent doesn't include that language yet.
- W-9: looks good.
- Vendor onboarding form: to complete vendor setup in our finance system we need a filled vendor onboarding form (banking details + remittance address) and a signed vendor agreement or DocuSign completion. I'm attaching our onboarding template — if you can populate and return it that will speed PO issuance.

PO / timing: once we have the completed onboarding form + COI with the additional-insured endorsement (or equivalent wording), Procurement will issue a PO. Target timeline: 3 business days from receipt of all items.

I'll flag the record in Jira (PROC-3287) and follow up with Priya on PO assignment. If you want, we can also accept a redline PDF of the COI and confirm whether it meets requirements.

Next steps (action items):
- Samantha: send updated COI with additional-insured endorsement or insurer remark (ASAP) [attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.docx]
- Priya (cc): allocate PO number once documents are in our system

Thanks,
